# Jacopo Castellano

> Personal site of Jacopo Castellano, a Berlin-based senior software engineer and video designer. It holds his blog on software, AI and creative coding, a portfolio of software, video, motion and installation work, a free AI news digest updated every 48 hours, and a store of 3D model and animation packs.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jacopocastellano.com/)
- [About](https://jacopocastellano.com/about/): Background, skills and experience.
- [Contact](https://jacopocastellano.com/contact/)
- [Blog](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/): All articles, newest first. RSS: https://jacopocastellano.com/rss.xml
- [Portfolio](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/)
- [AI Digest](https://jacopocastellano.com/ai-digest/): The latest AI developments in a 2-minute read. RSS: https://jacopocastellano.com/ai-digest/rss.xml
- [Store](https://jacopocastellano.com/store/): 3D model packs and animation packs.

## Blog
- [AI Weekly Digest: The Top 10 Things to Know This Week (Week of October 19, 2026)](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/ai-weekly-digest-week-of-2026-10-19/): AI-found bugs swamp open source while agents breach 2,250 cloud tenants, OpenAI seeks a $1.25T valuation and seals off its training runs, and LLM prices fall up to 80%.
- [close-tab: Claude Code closes its own terminal tab when the work is done](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/close-tab-claude-code-closes-its-own-tab/): A small Claude Code skill for iTerm2. End your last message with 'close the session' and the tab closes after the work is finished.
- [AI Weekly Digest: The Top 10 Things to Know This Week (Week of October 12, 2026)](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/ai-weekly-digest-week-of-2026-10-12/): Google ships Gemini 4 Argon and Meta returns with Muse Wonder, Anthropic reports $16.8B quarterly revenue and opens up to METR, and AI-written code outgrows Git.
- [From 2,037 to 1,440 contacts: cleaning macOS Contacts with Claude Code](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/rubricai-cleaning-macos-contacts-claude-code/): One evening of cleaning my address book with Claude Code, turned into Rubricai, an open-source skill that deduplicates, merges and completes macOS Contacts with reviewed plans.
- [AI Weekly Digest: The Top 10 Things to Know This Week (Week of October 5, 2026)](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/ai-weekly-digest-week-of-2026-10-05/): Anthropic discloses a Claude agent that sent a false police tip, OpenAI ships GPT-6 to everyone and 719 math manuscripts, and decision models draw a $7.5B bet.
- [tab-tag: a name and a colour for every Claude Code tab in iTerm2](https://jacopocastellano.com/blog/tab-tag-iterm2-claude-code/): A Claude Code mod that gives each session's iTerm2 tab its own colour and a one- or two-word name taken from the first prompt.

## Portfolio
- [Omaggio a Marcello Morandini](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/omaggio-a-marcello-morandini/): Black and white animations inspired by the geometric work of Marcello Morandini.
- [Rubricai](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/rubricai/): A Claude Code skill that deduplicates, merges and completes the macOS Contacts address book, one reviewed plan at a time.
- [Philharmonie Berlin in Blender](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/philharmonie-berlin-blender/): A 3D model of the main hall of the Philharmonie Berlin, built to visualise scenographies I have in mind.
- [Orchestra Instruments](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/orchestra-instruments/): 36 orchestral instruments as 3D models, built from Python scripts in Blender and sold as a pack.
- [tab-tag](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/tab-tag/): A Claude Code mod that gives each session's iTerm2 tab its own colour and a one- or two-word name taken from the first prompt.
- [Brickwise](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/brickwise/): A Claude Code skill that explains a codebase or any topic as an interactive 3D brick model. Brick size shows complexity.
- [Amazon Order Reporter](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/amazon-order-reporter/): A Manifest V3 Chrome extension that exports amazon.de order history for a chosen period as a per-item CSV.
- [Audio Filter](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/audio-filter/): A real-time voice filter for macOS that pipes any preset (chipmunk, robot, deep villain) into Teams, Zoom, Discord, or any app that picks a microphone.
- [TabChroma](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/tab-chroma/): A Claude Code hook plugin that changes your iTerm2 tab color, badge, and title based on what Claude is currently doing.
- [PowderPaint](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/powderpaint/): Markdown-to-slideshow presentation framework built with Flask, featuring multiple layouts, keyboard navigation, and multimedia support.
- [Friday in H2O](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/friday-in-h2o/): Video mapping, projections, and piano — a Doppelganger piece blending live performance with digital water and light.
- [VARK - Video Archiver](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/vark/): A Flask-based web application for managing, organizing, and analyzing large video collections with AI-powered tagging, face recognition, and audio transcription.
- [Spilling Ink with Two Squares](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/spilling-ink-two-squares/): Digital ink simulation constrained within two geometric frames — a study in fluid dynamics and visual tension.
- [Password Manager](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/password-manager/): A desktop password manager built with Python and tkinter, featuring Fernet encryption and master password protection.
- [Spilling Ink](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/spilling-ink/): Generative ink simulation — digital fluids spreading across a virtual surface, exploring the beauty of controlled chaos.
- [Signal Flow](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/signal-flow/): A visual study of signal and interference — projected patterns pulsing between order and noise.
- [Squaring](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/squaring/): Geometric exploration in motion — squares folding, splitting, and reassembling in an evolving visual composition.
- [Prompt Manager](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/prompt-manager/): A CLI tool for managing and filling reusable prompt templates for ChatGPT and LLMs.
- [Video Converter](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/video-converter/): Python scripts for converting video files to the Hap codec using FFmpeg, with single-file and batch folder processing.
- [Tidy Garderobe](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/tidy-garderobe/): A Python file organizer that categorizes and sorts files from Desktop, Downloads, or any directory by extension.
- [The Whisperer](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/the-whisperer/): A wrapper for OpenAI Whisper for video and audio transcription, translation, and subtitle generation.
- [Video Mapping - MWT](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/video-mapping-mwt/): Video mapping work for the MWT project — architectural surfaces transformed through projected light and motion.
- [Armentum Squares](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/armentum-squares/): Video projections for Armentum performed by Incolbalet in Cali, Colombia — geometric visual patterns in dialogue with contemporary dance.
- [Doppelganger](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/doppelganger/): A selection of works from the Doppelganger project — an exploration of doubled forms, mirrored gestures, and the uncanny space between original and reflection.
- [Gonzalo Galguera](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/gonzalo-galguera/): Trailer for choreographer Gonzalo Galguera's 2015 work — a portrait of movement captured through the lens of video design.
- [Armentum](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/armentum/): Video design and projections for Armentum, a contemporary dance piece performed by Incolbalet in Cali, Colombia.
- [Diva](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/diva/): Excerpts from Diva — video design for a ballet production by choreographer Gonzalo Galguera with Magdeburg Ballet.
- [Dornröschen](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/dornroschen/): Teaser for Dornröschen (Sleeping Beauty) — video design and projections breathing new light into the classic fairy tale on stage.
- [Backup Scripts](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/backup-scripts/): Collection of bash scripts for performing various types of backups, including incremental and full system backups.
- [Pi Games](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/pi-games/): Simple Python script for mental revision exercises of the first 2000 digits of pi.
- [Steam Powered Stream Snatcher](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/youtube-downloader/): Command-line tool for downloading YouTube videos with elegance and efficiency.
- [Licht](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/licht/): A study on light - an experimental video exploring the behavior and aesthetics of light through digital manipulation.
- [Eden](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/eden/): Stop-motion video based on artwork by Luigina Mazzocca (La foresta nel mare, 2019).
- [Dracula](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/dracula/): Video design and projections for a full-length ballet based on Bram Stoker's novel, featuring pre-recorded choreographic footage synchronized live during performances.
- [Panino Films Website](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/panino-films/): Official website for Panino Films Video Productions, built with modern web technologies.
- [Beethoven 9th Symphony](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/beethoven-9/): Video projections for performances of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony, creating visual accompaniment for the iconic choral finale.
- [Lookout](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/lookout/): Short experimental video exploring perspective and observation.
- [Lak](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/lak/): Video editing and production for a contemporary dance piece by Danza Nacional Contemporánea de Colombia.
- [Elective Affinities](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/elective-affinities/): Video design and projections for a dance piece inspired by Goethe's novel Die Wahlverwandtschaften.
- [MWT - Memory](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/mwt-memory/): Trailer for MWT Memory, featuring video projections and artistic visuals.
- [Carmina Burana](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/carmina-burana/): Video design and projections for Carl Orff's iconic cantata, performed with the Philharmonisches Kammerorchester Berlin and the National Ballet Company of Colombia.
- [The Lost Steps](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/the-lost-steps/): UX, UI, and video design for a ballet based on Alejo Carpentier's novel, featuring 11 semi-translucent columns with 13 different scene combinations.
- [Stabat Mater](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/stabat-mater/): Video design for Rossini's Stabat Mater, featuring 73 synchronized videos integrated with live orchestra, choir, and ballet over a 10-12 month production period.
- [Interview with Nacho Duato](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/nacho-duato-interview/): Video editing and motion design for an interview with the renowned Spanish choreographer Nacho Duato.
- [Chuck Norris Jokes for MS Teams](https://jacopocastellano.com/portfolio/chuck-norris-teams/): Microsoft Teams integration that delivers Chuck Norris jokes to brighten up your workday.
